en: A toy train set. The little engine is worn smooth where small hands pushed it round and round.
A basketball hoop on the wall. The ball sits underneath it, a little flat.
A model plane hangs from the ceiling. It sways in a draught nobody can feel.
A row of building blocks, stacked and knocked down so often that their corners are round.
Building blocks, sorted by colour with great care.
A skateboard rests against the wall. Its wheels still spin.
A dartboard. Every dart is stuck dead in the middle.
The track of the toy train runs all round the floor. Someone laid it with a lot of patience.
A soft cushion shaped like a Pokémon. It has been hugged a great deal.
